procedure.title: 機能テスト手順(ad-hoc / playbook / 行内オプション / インベントリ切替)

steps.title: ad-hoc: 全6ホストの疎通確認
steps.command: ansible all -i samples/local_test/inventory.ini -e '{"INVENTORY": "samples/local_test/inventory.ini", "CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' -m shell -a 'echo "{{CHECK_LABEL}}: host={{ inventory_hostname }}"'
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and
out("機能テスト: host=web01") and out("機能テスト: host=web02") and
out("機能テスト: host=web03") and out("機能テスト: host=db01") and
out("機能テスト: host=db02") and out("機能テスト: host=mon01") and
not out("UNREACHABLE|FAILED")

steps.title: playbook: 基本実行(-l による対象絞り込み)
steps.command: ansible-playbook -i samples/local_test/inventory.ini -l webservers -e '{"INVENTORY": "samples/local_test/inventory.ini", "CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' samples/local_test/site_check.yml
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and out("web01") and not out("db01|db02|mon01") and
not out("failed=[1-9]|unreachable=[1-9]")

steps.title: playbook: 行内 -e による実行時上書き
steps.command: ansible-playbook -i samples/local_test/inventory.ini -l web01 -e '{"INVENTORY": "samples/local_test/inventory.ini", "CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' samples/local_test/show_var.yml -e HOGE=PIYO
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and out("HOGE=PIYO") and not out("HOGE=FUGA") and
not out("failed=[1-9]|unreachable=[1-9]")

steps.title: playbook: 行内 -i によるインベントリ切替
steps.command: ansible-playbook -l all -e '{"INVENTORY": "samples/local_test/inventory.ini", "CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' -i samples/local_test/inventory_web.ini samples/local_test/show_var.yml && ansible-playbook -l all -e '{"INVENTORY": "samples/local_test/inventory.ini", "CHECK_LABEL": "機能テスト", "HOGE": "FUGA"}' -i samples/local_test/inventory_db.ini samples/local_test/show_var.yml -e HOGE=DB_RUN
steps.criteria:
rc == 0 and
out("HOGE=FUGA \(host=web01\)") and out("HOGE=FUGA \(host=web03\)") and
out("HOGE=DB_RUN \(host=db01\)") and out("HOGE=DB_RUN \(host=db02\)") and
not out("failed=[1-9]|unreachable=[1-9]")

steps.title: bash: ローカルステップとの混在確認
steps.criteria: rc == 0 and "local step on" in stdout and out("Linux")
